deviation: a preregistered stop condition fired during execution and the study continued after an outcome-blind repair, rather than halting

stop_conditions: the D0036 TargetSpec hash differs from X0008's sealed 4k arm
a lattice cell cannot train or evaluate
the geometry registry hash differs from the manifest's pin
membership or the frozen budget mapping fails
what_the_preregistration_said.implication: under the preregistered text, cells that cannot train are a stop; the study instead repaired the encoder and retried the cells

what_happened: the new GEO encoder raised ValueError('need at least one array to stack') on D0036's EMPTY validation split (fractions 1.0/0.0/0.0): np.stack([]) has no zero-row guard, unlike the RAW branch's np.zeros((0, 768)). 32 GEO cells recorded INVALID; one further cell was RUNNING when the first driver was stopped and was marked INVALID as an orphan.
the repair was a two-line zero-row guard in cvslab/nnue.py encode_records - a pure input-path fix that changes no supervision, no design, no seed and no metric.

to retry the cells without discarding the frozen study, the Lab gained replacement semantics: a cell whose only attempt is INVALID may hold one later COMPLETED run; the crash stays immutable evidence beside its retry; two COMPLETED runs remain unresolvable. Tested in tests/test_experiment.py::test_an_invalid_attempt_may_be_replaced_by_one_completed_run.
all 33 affected cells were retried and COMPLETED; X0012 sealed 260/260 with every crash/retry pair listed in the membership's replaced_cells.
outcome_blindness_of_the_repair: before the fix, only run STATUSES had been observed (counts of COMPLETED/INVALID); no loss value, contrast or summary had been computed or read
the fix touches only the encoding of an empty input list; it cannot change any filled split

the retry runs are deterministic re-executions of the same frozen cells (same ablation, seed, dataset, recipe and exam), and the replacement rule was added to the Lab as a general capability with tests, not as a study-specific patch
what_did_not_change: the lattice (3 families x 4 budgets + the GEO linear floor x 20 seeds), the ladder, the geometry manifest, the teacher/exam contract, the seeds, the student-compute regime
the 227 cells that completed on their first attempt
the analysis plan and the frozen preregistration file (its 280-cell arithmetic error is recorded additively in s14-preregistration-erratum.json)
consequences_for_interpretation: the global frontier statements rest on a deviated execution: the deviation is confined to 33 GEO cells whose first attempt crashed before training completed, and their retries are ordinary frozen-cell executions
a pristine preregistered replication would need its own preregistration; nothing here is rewritten

evidence.replacements_ledger: tools/s14/s14-replacements-ledger.json (33 entries, crash and retry run ids with reasons, derived from the store)
